paragraphs: **Bhavya Agrawal** is a Director of Photography, filmmaker, and visual storyteller working across documentaries, live events, commercial films, and culture-driven stories. A graduate of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) with a B.Des in Fashion Communication, his approach combines visual design with cinematic storytelling — from intimate narratives to large-scale productions. His work spans world record documentaries, cultural and spiritual films, events, short films, and commercial storytelling. Based in Madhya Pradesh, India, and available worldwide.
